evidence: Scope: all 43 files of the frozen task. (1) Live credentials: a scan of every file, including the 1.9 MB bundle and the lockfile, for provider key shapes (sk-, sk-ant-, sk-or-, AKIA, ghp_, github_pat_, xox*, AIza, JWT, Bearer, PEM PRIVATE KEY) returned nothing. The only credential-shaped settings are task.toml:34 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"` (a ${VAR} template) and task.toml:35 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`; the [verifier.env] block is byte-equal to the frozen template (diff of task.toml shows only name/description/keywords/metadata lines differ). The word 'token' elsewhere is the syntax tokenizer or the per-run crypto.randomUUID() postMessage nonce (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:386, public/runner.html:3), not a secret. The app has no sign-in (instruction.md:5 'without signing in'), so there are no demo credentials at all. (2) Real personal data: environment/assets/seed_data.json is `{"snippets": [], "note": ...}` with no people. The only e-mail address in the task is environment/Dockerfile:20 `turing@local.invalid` (reserved TLD, template line). No personal names, phone numbers or non-loopback IPs (only 0.0.0.0 and 127.0.0.1). (3) Host paths: no match for drive-letter paths, /Users/, /home/<user>, file:///, the workspace name or the author's user/e-mail identifiers in any file, bundle included; the bundle has 0 sourceMappingURL references and no .map, .env, .db, .pem, .key or .log file is shipped (the only dotfile is tests/.dockerignore, template-identical). (4) Unpinned remote fetch: solution/solve.sh performs no network access (a /proc open-file check, rm of the database files, `cp -a`). solution/app/package.json pins every dependency to an exact version; package-lock.json has 178 resolved entries, all https://registry.npmjs.org, each with an integrity hash (178/178), no git/file/http sources. The golden loads nothing remote at runtime: public/index.html references only /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, the CSS has no @import or url(), the URLs inside the bundle are XML namespaces and library doc links in strings, and server.js:16 sends `default-src 'self'; ... connect-src 'self'`. environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template; npm globals and pip are version-pinned (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7). tests/test.sh, tools/restart_mcp.py and tools/score.py are template-identical and reference only 127.0.0.1:3000. No curl, wget, git clone, npx or @latest anywhere. (5) Injection payload: no instruction-to-judge phrasing (ignore previous/system prompt/award pass/etc.) in the brief, notes, seed, criteria, prompts or golden source; a Unicode scan for zero-width and bidi control characters found none outside the bundle, and the 22 hits inside solution/app/public/assets/index.js are acorn's `nonASCIIidentifierChars` table and the HTML named-entity table (zwj, zwnj, lrm, rlm, ZeroWidthSpace, InvisibleTimes...), i.e. library data, not hidden text. All files decode as UTF-8. Evidence index: 18 of 22 artifact hashes match as stored; the 4 under run-4e686738.../colderwater-playground-devtools__Rc3y2sT (result.json, verifier/reward.json, verifier/scored/reward-details.json, verifier/gates/reward-details.json) match only after CRLF->LF normalisation because the worktree checkout is `i/lf w/crlf`; content is the same. That evidence is not needed for this static row. Weak-app/alternative probe: a builder that loads CDN assets is explicitly allowed (integration.md:5, security.md:3), so the row does not penalise a conforming alternative; a task carrying a pasted provider key or a host path would have been caught by the scans above. NOTES (not defects of this candidate): (a) base images are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned (`node:22-bookworm-slim`, `python:3.12-slim`), apt packages are unversioned, the global npm installs have no lockfile for transitive dependencies, and Chromium is downloaded at build by the pinned Playwright CLI; all of this is byte-identical template-controlled content, the deterministic sheet classes unpinned apt as a NOTE, and AGENTS.md forbids editing template files. (b) tests/Dockerfile:24-29,41 configures the judge with sandbox bypass; template-controlled and outside this row. (c) server.js:8 also honours an undocumented SQLITE_PATH environment variable; harmless, not a secret.
